title: L. Annius
summary: Raleigh names L. Annius in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). L. Annius, Lieutenant to Vespasian, who tooke Gerassa. He is not Annius of the earlier books. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter X, §. VII, sig. 250b
